gather_tensor_across_gpus: gather a PyTorch tensor from all GPUs in a distributed training setup using all_gather
gather_nograd_tensor_no_grad: gather a tensor across all processes without computing gradients for inference or evaluation
varsize_gather_variable_length_tensors: gather tensors of different sizes across processes by padding to the maximum size
get_rank_world_size_barrier: get the current process rank, world size, or synchronize processes with a distributed barrier
weighted_average_loss_across_gpus: compute a weighted average of loss values across all GPUs in distributed training
